note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: Fur keeps dominating the November feed: a carousel posted today (15K likes) pairs a voluminous brown faux-fur cropped jacket with light-wash wide-leg jeans and black-and-white zebra-print pointed shoes; a 17K-like subway reel wears a cropped brown faux-fur coat open over a black lace bralette, and a 7.4K-like carousel centers a leopard-print faux-fur jacket with low-rise jeans. Meanwhile the week's biggest fashion viral (770K likes) is a creator styling nine outfits as typefaces — Times New Roman as a pinstripe suit, Impact as tactical streetwear, Papyrus as bohemian layers, Futura as all-white tech — and Supreme's fall/winter lookbook (28K likes) leans on baroque-print puffers, Fair Isle cardigans and fur trapper hats.
trends.title: Faux-fur cropped jackets and the viral 'style different fonts' challenge — brown faux fur, zebra print, baroque puffers

trends.details: The feed flipped to Christmas fast: a 64K-like carousel centers a tall tree in red velvet ribbons, heart ornaments, red berries and warm white lights with gold reindeer statues at its base, a 44K-like cinematic 'Our Home at Christmas' tour layers wreaths, garlands, red taper candles and a chandelier wrapped in greenery, and a 15K-like reel catches a partner who fully decorated the house by November 2. Budget hauls ride along — a 17K-like Dollar Tree roundup of $1.25 pine-tree dinnerware, velvet ribbon trees and $1 velvet ornaments — while Thanksgiving still gets its moment: a 21K-like reel builds a centerpiece from a white-pumpkin vase of hydrangeas and pumpkin candle holders with pinecones and pears.
trends.title: Christmas decor takes over in early November — red velvet trees, Dollar Tree hauls, Thanksgiving tablescapes

trends.details: Brown lips are the defining fall look: a 39K-like tutorial swatches a KIKO Milano brown liner, matte brown lipstick and shimmery gloss as 'my brown fall lip combo,' and a 29K-like 'lip combo for november' layers a MAC pencil with Rhode's Peptide Lip Treatment from a pumpkin-shaped case. Warm glam fills out the rest — a 21K-like warm fall tutorial pairs pink cream blush with a JUDYDOLL eye palette and CANMAKE mascara, a 41K-like routine centers Charlotte Tilbury pink blush with Airbrush setting spray, and a 71K-like GRWM builds a Qawali-night look with defined eyes, rosy cheeks and glossy lips.
trends.title: Brown lip combos lead the fall glam — espresso lips, cream blush, warm eyes
